optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The resume and work samples establish the candidate’s activities related to model release, on‑call duty, dashboard monitoring, offline evaluation, and model card writing. They do not provide evidence of coordination with the search platform team beyond the release ticket, nor do they confirm that the candidate recorded which checks were theirs versus the platform team’s.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review is required to assess fit for the Ranking Engineer role.

evidence.text: Released five ranking models to the production search service of the marketplace between 2023 and 2025, each under a traffic ramp from one per cent to full traffic and each on a release ticket in my name.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of release and ramping

evidence.text: Read the live relevance and conversion dashboards after every release and in the weekly ranking review, and rolled one release back in 2024 when the conversion dashboard showed a regression on low-traffic categories.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of dashboard reading and rollback

evidence.text: Took on-call duty for ranking incidents throughout that period; the feature store outage of autumn 2024 was mine to handle, and the search incident log carries my incident record for it.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of on-call duty and incident handling

evidence.text: Evaluated every model offline against held-out interaction data under the evaluation protocol agreed with data science before it went to the release review with the search platform team, where the release ticket recorded which checks were mine.
evidence.notes: Mentions release review with platform team but does not specify coordination details or check ownership

hiringEvidencePacket.auditSummary: The candidate’s resume and work samples provide strong evidence for most requirements, particularly release management, on‑call duty, dashboard monitoring, offline evaluation, and model card writing. The only gap is the lack of explicit evidence for coordination with the search platform team and ownership of checks, which requires follow‑up. No protected characteristics are inferred, and no hiring decision is made at this stage.
limitations: Evidence is limited to the candidate’s self‑reported resume and associated work samples; independent verification of release tickets and incident logs is recommended.
